newsitem.title: USA: Secure Computing posts expected Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Secure Computing posts expected Q4 loss.

text.p: Secure Computing said several large pending sales that were expectd to close in the fourth quarter ended December 31 did not close, contributing to a loss of $5.7 million in the period, or $0.38 a share.
A Secure Computing spokesman said the sales that did not close were worth a total of about $2.5 million.
The company reported net income of $104,000 in the fourth quarter of 1995. Sales in the latest period reached $9.0 million, compared to $9.1 million one year ago.
The company had announced earlier this month its results would not meet a consensus estimate of net income of $0.13 a share in the quarter.
Secure Computing develops computer network security systems. Its shares closed unchanged Thursday at 8.
